infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: ANITECH GCS connects to your vehicle and Raspberry Pi gateway on the local network.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ANITECH GCS uses your location to center the map when no vehicle GPS is available.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ANITECH GCS requires microphone access for pilot voice assistance.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: ANITECH GCS uses speech recognition to analyze flight inquiries and status queries.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow ANITECH GCS to show your phone location on the map when no vehicle is connected.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow ANITECH GCS to access captured flight media.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow ANITECH GCS to save flight photos and videos.

plugins.microphonePermission: ANITECH GCS requires microphone access for pilot voice assistance.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: ANITECH GCS uses speech recognition to analyze flight inquiries and status queries.
